description.text: Curriculum: Courses of Politics and Foreign Language are exempted; Introduction to China and Modern Chinese Language is required; - Others courses are taken as the same as Chinese students. - The student who has completed the curriculum, passed the examinations and successfully defended the dissertation will be issued a diploma and conferred with Master/Doctoral degree.

duration.text: The Physical Chemistry at Jilin University is a 3 Years long program for international students, taught in English.

fees.text: Application Fee: $ 150 USD Service Fee: $ 50 USD Tuition fee: $ 4027 USD/per year ￥ 29000 CNY/per year

materials.text: 1.Photocopy of valid passport With photo, passport number &expiration date and name included. 2.Passport-sized photo A passport-sized photo taken recently of the applicant. 3.Master's degree diploma Graduation certificate should be in Chinese or English.If not, it should be translated into Chinese or English and be notarized. 4.Transcript of postgraduate school 5.Two recommendation letters From professor,associate professor or equivalents.
